{"app": "shell", "action": "command", "command": "cat > /tmp/make_agenda.py << 'EOF'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

# Create image
img = Image.new('RGB', (800, 400), color='white')
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Try to load a font
try:
    font_title = ImageFont.truetype('DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf', 28)
    font_text = ImageFont.truetype('DejaVuSans.ttf', 20)
except:
    font_title = ImageFont.load_default()
    font_text = ImageFont.load_default()

draw.text((50, 30), 'Meeting Agenda', fill='black', font=font_title)

items = [
    ('13:00-13:30', 'Introductions by Linda'),
    ('13:30-14:10', 'Agenda by Davide'),
    ('14:10-14:30', 'Strategy by Charlie'),
]

y = 100
for time, event in items:
    draw.text((50, y), time, fill='black', font=font_text)
    draw.text((250, y), event, fill='black', font=font_text)
    y += 50

img.save('tasks/3-50/testbed/data/agenda.jpg')
print('saved')
EOF
python3 /tmp/make_agenda.py"}
